integrity: Analytic proof with 464 supplementary finite checks; public authorship not claimed; no independent review.
scientific_limitations: Finite real dimension >=2, strictly positive penalty weights and parameter; Euclidean proximal metric, coordinate-maximum perturbation norm, and normalized quadratic weight energy for the envelope. The KKT and generalized Jacobian are established prior results; only the sharp global norm optimizations and anisotropy classifications are asserted as the new finding. Earlier equivalent norm formula remains a possible historical-priority risk.
title: Sharp weight-anisotropy envelope and active-support threshold for squared weighted \(\ell_1\) proximal maps
